messages:
elaine: Draft announce post + benchmark summary ready. Need quick eng + docs check: changelog text, canonical docs URL, and canary timing before we schedule embargo lift.
sam: Paste the changelog snippet here and wean confirm. Also want to know if we should call out fallback model in the public copy.
amit: Changelog suggestion: `- rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 36h; auto-fallback to 'quant-lite' on errors`
amit: Canary policy id is `canary-release-2026-04a` if you want the tag in the notes.
carla: Docs will publish at /docs/release/2026-04 when content is locked. I can publish tonight if we get the final text by 18:00 PT.
elaine: Webinar planned Thu 04/02 17:00 PT. Registration flow needs UTMs and SFDC mapping. Proposed UTM: utm_campaign=release_apr26&utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email
salesbot: Suggested SFDC routing: queue=inbound_ml_products; add tags: product=AprilRelease, lead_priority=high for paid traffic. We can wire this once UTMs final.
sam: Canary windows (eng approved): start Thu 04/02 01:00 UTC at 10% to variant `v3-quant-lite`, hold 6h, ramp to 50% next day at 08:00 UTC, full ramp 36h after start if no regressions. Rollback target: `v2-stable`.
carla: Will publish and return final docs URL here. I
gree to add a short TL;DR and a one-line note on fallback behavior.
elaine: Please react with :thumbsup: if your lane is green. Marketing needs final go/no-go by EOD to set embargo for Fri morning.
amit: :thumbsup:
salesbot: :thumbsup: SFDC mapping queued.
carla: :thumbsup: Publishing at 18:00 PT and will post the canonical link.
